title: Obedience Obedience
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads Exodus 20:12 and gives its promise (a long life in the land), says why children obey parents, teachers and school rules, and names results of disobedience even when no one sees.

floor.question: Why do we obey the teacher at school?

representations: a chart: rule, why it helps, what happens if broken
steps: Pick a school rule and say why it helps.
Say what follows when it is broken.

board.do: Point at the school rules poster.
board.say: Pick one rule. What happens if it is broken?

board.do: Wait for the child to give a result.

listen_for: Only when I agree with them
misconceptions.ask: When should a child obey his parents and teachers?

listen_for: Nothing, if the teacher is not looking
misconceptions.ask: What may follow disobeying school rules?
misconceptions.repair: List the results: danger, lost trust, punishment.

misconceptions.ask: Whose instructions should a child follow at school?
misconceptions.repair: Link school rules with safe, orderly learning.

misconceptions.ask: What does Exodus 20:12 promise to those who honour their parents?
misconceptions.repair: Read the second half of Exodus 20:12 aloud twice and underline "live long".

checks.question: What does Exodus 20:12 promise?
checks.answer: A long life in the land

checks.question: Name one result of disobeying a school rule.
